scale_correction_direction: Use the accepted adult actor body (about 60 px tall), not its transparent 128 px canvas, as the visual size reference. Review furniture dimensions and projection together before expanding the scene; preserve accepted actor scale. No new numerical furniture dimensions are approved yet.
recommended_next_review: A small scene assembled in the actual renderer from separate native64 floor, wall, corner, door and furniture assets, showing clear passageways, an accepted NPC, furniture at the same world scale and movement through the door. Keep the full camp pending.
